scripts.build: tsc -b && yarn workspace @music-tag/backend build:aliases && yarn workspace @music-tag/frontend build:assets
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "yarn workspace @music-tag/backend start" "yarn workspace @music-tag/frontend start"
scripts.dev: (yarn workspace @music-tag/backend db:local:start || yarn workspace @music-tag/backend db:local:create) && yarn workspace @music-tag/shared build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend,shared,db,studio -c blue,green,yellow,red,#FFA500 "yarn workspace @music-tag/backend dev" "yarn workspace @music-tag/frontend dev" "yarn workspace @music-tag/shared dev" "docker logs -f music-tags-db" "yarn workspace @music-tag/backend db:studio"
